ideas.pitch: An automated OSINT investigation dashboard that correlates public social media handles, image metadata, and forum posts into a single interactive node graph.
ideas.problem_statement: What if you could solve real-world digital mysteries using only public footprints? ReConCTF ’26 challenges participants to trace online footprints, analyze metadata, verify imagery, and uncover hidden aliases.
ideas.title: OSINT-Scope: Automated Digital Footprint Aggregator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines graph intelligence architecture inspired by winning AML risk engines, giving investigators a professional-grade tooling experience that stands out against manual CTF workflows.

ideas.pitch: A rapid-verification tool for geolocation and image forensics challenges that cross-references image metadata with public historical satellite imagery and shadow-angle calculations.
ideas.problem_statement: Challenges Span Across Geolocation, Forensics, and Web Recon, requiring participants to verify imagery and analyze metadata.
ideas.title: GeoVerify: EXIF & Satellite Ground-Truth Verifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles the specific bottleneck of manual geolocation in OSINT CTFs by offering automated shadow and terrain validation, saving hours during a tight 24-48 hour window.

ideas.pitch: A recursive OSINT reconnaissance scanner optimized for finding hidden aliases across hundreds of public web platforms without triggering rate limits or violating public-only rules.
ideas.problem_statement: Uncover hidden aliases, connect scattered clues, and hunt down hidden information across the internet using only publicly available sources.
ideas.title: AliasTrace: Cross-Platform Username Enumeration Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features robust defensive rate-limiting and asynchronous scraping pipelines inspired by award-winning personal agent tool architectures, ensuring reliable execution under CTF constraints.

ideas.pitch: A specialized browser extension and backend pipeline designed to instantly extract hidden strings, embedded file headers, and steganographic layers from challenge artifacts.
ideas.problem_statement: Challenges Span Across Geolocation, Forensics, and Web Recon, where participants must analyze metadata and capture the flags.
ideas.title: MetadataSentinel: Automated Forensics and Steganography Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-speed execution for forensics puzzles, directly addressing the time pressure of a 24-48 hour CTF event by reducing repetitive command-line tasks.

ideas.pitch: A real-time collaborative workspace for CTF teams featuring shared evidence pins, automated flag format regex validation, and synchronized timeline reconstruction.
ideas.problem_statement: Team Size: 2–4 Participants solve diverse OSINT challenges, connect scattered clues, and submit discovered flags to the live scoreboard.
ideas.title: ClueCanvas: Collaborative OSINT Flag Submission & Evidence Board
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves team coordination friction during fast-paced online CTFs, ensuring zero duplicated effort and rapid handoffs between web recon and forensics specialists.
